title: Inherited Land Mutation & Patta Transfer (Paternal/Maternal Deceased)
title_ta: தந்தை/தாய் மறைவுக்குப் பின் வாரிசு அடிப்படையில் பட்டா மாறுதல் முறை
governing_rules: Tamil Nadu Patta Pass Book Act, 1983 & Rules 1987
statutory_fee: Rs. 60 (Online processing fee) + Sub-division fee if partitioned

steps.step_name: Obtain Official Death & Legal Heir Certificates
steps.description: Ensure the original death certificate of the deceased title holder and a valid Legal Heir Certificate (Varisu Saandrizh) issued by the competent Tahsildar are in hand.

steps.step_name: Partition Deed / Registered Release Deed (if multiple heirs)
steps.description: If there are multiple legal heirs (e.g. siblings, surviving spouse), obtain either a Registered Partition Deed, a Registered Release/Relinquishment Deed, or signed No-Objection Affidavits consenting to the transfer.

steps.step_name: Verify Existing Computer Patta & Land Records
steps.description: Download the latest Patta and Chitta extract from eservices.tn.gov.in using Survey Number and Subdivision number to confirm the deceased person's recorded extent.
Submit form on TN e-Services with uploaded PDF copies of Legal Heir Certificate, Death Certificate, Parent Deed, and Property Tax receipt. Obtain Application Reference (CAN/Ack No).

steps.step_name: Village Administrative Officer (VAO) & Revenue Inspector (RI) Field Inquiry
steps.description: VAO inspects field boundaries, checks peaceful physical possession, validates genealogical facts, and forwards report to Zonal Deputy Tahsildar.

steps.step_name: Order by Zonal Deputy Tahsildar & Digitally Signed Patta Issuance
steps.description: Deputy Tahsildar approves mutation order. The new Patta is updated in Tamil Nilam database and available for instant download.

prerequisites: Registered Sale Deed / Settlement Deed of the deceased
Consent / NOC from other surviving legal heirs
caution_notes: If land area in existing Patta doesn't match the Registered Deed, a field measurement (FMB re-survey) will be triggered before mutation approval.
Never pay unauthorized intermediaries. Official fees are paid only via the government payment gateway.

title: Before-You-Buy Land Due Diligence & Title Verification Workflow
title_ta: நிலம் வாங்குவதற்கு முன் மேற்கொள்ள வேண்டிய சரிபார்ப்பு நடைமுறை
governing_rules: Registration Act 1908 & TN Patta Passbook Act

steps.description: Search TNREGINET for at least 30 years to check for mortgages, bank loans, prior court attachments, or undisclosed agreements of sale.
Verify unbroken link documents dating back at least 30 years to prove valid root of title and how the seller acquired the property.
Match the seller's name in the registered sale deed with the current name in the Tamil Nilam computer Patta. Verify survey number and extent in FMB sketch.
Conduct physical inspection with licensed surveyor to verify four boundaries (North, South, East, West) and reconcile physical ground measurement with document extent.
Confirm land is Ryotwari Punja/Nanja and not government Poramboke, Panchami, Temple (HR&CE), or Wakf land.

caution_notes: Any discrepancy between seller stated area and registered document area must be resolved before executing a Sale Agreement.
An Encumbrance Certificate only records registered acts; it does not reflect unregistered inheritance claims or pending unindexed civil suits.

title: Area Mismatch Reconciliation & Revenue Demarcation Procedure
title_ta: நிலப் பரப்பளவு வேறுபாடு நிவர்த்தி மற்றும் எல்லை அளவீட்டு முறை
governing_rules: Tamil Nadu Survey and Boundaries Act, 1923
statutory_fee: Demarcation fee Rs. 400 - 800 per survey mark

steps.description: Audit the exact difference in square feet/cents between Registered Deed, Current Patta, and FMB sketch.

steps.step_name: Apply for Official Taluk Surveyor Field Inspection
steps.description: Submit demarcation petition to Tahsildar with copies of deed and fee challan to measure land using electronic total station (ETS).
Tahsildar issues statutory notice to all adjacent boundary owners informing them of the inspection date.
Surveyor measures land against village revenue survey map. If sub-division error occurred in UDR scheme, surveyor submits report for UDR rectification.

prerequisites: Original Title Deed or certified copy
caution_notes: Do not register a new sale deed with unverified area differences as it creates a permanent cloud on title.
System labels this as 'POTENTIAL INCONSISTENCY' requiring field verification.
